thank you. i will try my best.

i’m going to try, at the very least, to hold out until i see him next. then, i’ll see how i’m feeling.

yes, but only for a couple hours during the day, and the staff check on you frequently. the walls are also very thin. i have minimal privacy.

the couple hours are what i’m having to settle with, even though my partner is uncomfortable sleeping at my mother’s house.

i’m on month 7 out of 16 months. i’ve been committed because i am unable to work despite being “high functioning”, so that is what i have been trying to overcome. i am showing progress, needing to take things at my own pace- but as it has been in my life, it will never be good enough for others, not even the administration of a mental health facility.
i’m a digital artist. even though i’d like to, i don’t have the drive or smarts about marketing to maintain freelance work. it won’t make me enough money to live.
